evidence.description: Direct access to EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared.isLoggedIn within a Task

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the 'EcosiaAuthenticationService' singleton via its '.shared' property to initialize its state and update data, creating a hard-coded dependency.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

candidates.explanation: The 'EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider' class contains mutable instance state (e.g., 'seedCount', 'currentProgress') that is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (via 'Task' blocks and '@MainActor' methods) without actor isolation, as the class itself is not an actor.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

candidates.explanation: The class uses 'nonisolated(unsafe)' for 'seedProgressManagerType' and 'accountsProviderFactory', allowing access to mutable state/logic without any visible safety invariants or synchronization.
candidates.title: Unjustified Unsafe Concurrency Escape Hatch
